name: segmented-control
title: Segmented Control
summary: Pick one of a few options that sit side by side.
description: Pick one of a few options that sit side by side. Content-sized segments on a field track, with a surface thumb that slides to the selected one. It is a radio group: one tab stop, arrow keys move and select. Behaviour comes from the Zag radio-group machine, through Ark UI's SegmentGroup in React, Vue and Svelte. Without JavaScript the native radios still work and the selected segment paints itself.

anatomy.description: role=radiogroup. The track: its height is the segments' height plus 2px padding (chips: no track, a 4px-padded row that scrolls sideways). Labels are never cut: when the options do not fit, the engine glue (segmented-control.logic.ts) sets data-overflow and the row scrolls sideways with no scrollbar, a veil in the track colour on the edge(s) with more (chips: a 16px mask fade; data-overflow-start and data-overflow-end, kept in step with the scroll position by lib/veil.ts), the focus ring on the option's edge, and the selected option scrolled into view at mount and when it changes. Options that fit: nothing changes.
The engine's indicator. It is given the selected segment's box as --left / --top / --width / --height on itself and travels on transform; hidden until measured. Carries kbd-instant.
One segment; data-state=checked|unchecked, data-focus-visible, data-disabled. An icon may precede the label.
The segment's text and accessible name; with icons it is also visually hidden (sr-only). In chips it is the label slot: an optional status dot, the text and an optional count.
Status dot inside the label (aria-hidden): 6px, coloured by the option's dot tone: blue|green|orange|red|purple|cyan|yellow|pink (the tag hues), ink-3 without a tone.
Native radio, visually hidden: focus, arrow keys and form value come from it.

options.description: Segments in order. Strings are accepted as value = label. Each may carry an icon (a node in React, the `icon` slot in Vue, the `icon` snippet in Svelte), a status `dot` (a tag hue: blue, green, orange, red, purple, cyan, yellow, pink; true for ink-3) and a `count` (a plain `count`), both rendered inside the label.

value.description: Selected value. Defaults to the first option.

variant.description: segments: content-sized segments on a field track. chips: separate 26px chips with a 4px gap and no track, for a filter row; the thumb still slides between them, and the row scrolls sideways when it overflows. size does not apply to chips.

size.description: The track's height, on the one control scale (an sm segmented control lines up with an sm Button or Select): xs 24px (20px segments, 12px labels; the compact switcher), sm 28px (24px, 12px), md 32px (28px, 13px), lg 36px (32px, 14px). Dimensions only: the track, thumb, hover, press and focus are the same at every size. Does not apply to chips.

shape.description: Left out, the app's shape: a pill, or rounded in a rounded app ("shape": "rounded" in the project's fndn.json). Named, it is that shape whatever the app's. pill: fully round track and thumb. rounded: the radius of a field of the same height on the track (radius.chip at xs and sm, radius.control at md and lg). The thumb is concentric (the track's radius less the 2px padding).

fill.description: Equal-width segments that share the root's width.

icons.description: Icon-only square segments; each label stays as the accessible name.

name.description: Form field name of the radios.

slots.icon: Icon of an option (Vue slot / Svelte snippet, called with the option). In React an option carries `icon` itself.

keyboard: Tab reaches the selected segment; the group is one tab stop
ArrowRight / ArrowDown select the next segment, ArrowLeft / ArrowUp the previous; they wrap
Home / End select the first / last enabled segment
notes: Give the group an aria-label (or aria-labelledby).
Icon-only segments keep their label as the accessible name.
A selection made from the keyboard moves the thumb instantly; the slide is for the pointer.
To select from outside, control `value`: React value / onValueChange, Vue v-model:value, Svelte bind:value.

motion: thumb: transform and width over duration.move with easing.move, only when the user selects; no slide on mount and none when fonts load or the container resizes

press: no background anywhere in the control. The pressed segment's label goes to ink and the segment scales to motion.press-scale over duration.press; pressing the selected segment also scales the thumb (its ::before, with the individual scale property, so the engine's translate is untouched)
chips: the same thumb, hover, press and keyboard rules as segments; an unselected chip never paints the thumb's look

overflow: the edge veils (chips: the edge fades) show and hide at once from the scroll position (lib/veil.ts, the same in every browser; no animation, no time involved); the selected option is scrolled into view instantly at mount, from the keyboard and under reduced motion, smoothly after a pointer pick; the thumb rides the scrolled content and never re-measures for a scroll; an option wider than the room between the veils shows its start, in both directions
mount: the thumb, data-overflow and the veils are measured before the first paint (a layout effect), so a fresh control (a docs page swap) never paints a frame without its thumb
